title: Hotel Mario Player 1 transition stall
symptom: Selecting Player 1 removes the menu text but never advances from the title background
expected: Selecting Player 1 opens the NEW / RESTORE submenu
revalidation_reason: The deterministic correction is verified headlessly; GUI verification is still required.

hypotheses.hardware_explanation: The CLI re-anchored the relative CD-i pointer at the press boundary after the title had changed its position, producing a different guest input packet from the intended hover-then-click sequence.
supporting_evidence: c012d17 stalls with the press-boundary re-anchor and reaches NEW / RESTORE when that re-anchor is removed.
04cc43b, 019fb59, and 7dc46a9 all reach NEW / RESTORE with the original hover-then-click behavior.
hypotheses.falsifying_test: Restore only the press-boundary absolute-pointer write while holding the ROM, disc, timing, and core revision fixed; the terminal framebuffer should remain unchanged if re-anchoring is irrelevant.

hypotheses.hardware_explanation: Selected XA sectors must update the ordinary data-buffer header while also placing a complete post-sync sector image in ADPCM buffer 4/5. Routing only the complete image to 0x2800/0x3200 deprived CD-RTOS of the data-buffer header it inspects during the transition.
supporting_evidence: With normalized input, c012d17 reaches NEW / RESTORE while 3e02bf4 stalls.
Changing only the 3e02bf4 delivery layout restores the known-good framebuffer hash.
Mono-I test_xa_play captures show timestamp/mode words changing in the ordinary buffers while DBUF reports audio buffer 4/5.
The CDIC manual places coding at ADPCM-buffer offset 11 and the 2304-byte payload at offset 12.
hypotheses.falsifying_test: On Mono-I hardware, capture the ordinary data-buffer header during selected XA delivery; unchanged header words would falsify the dual-routing model.

hypotheses.hardware_explanation: AUDCTL read or write semantics caused the title to wait after selecting Player 1.
supporting_evidence: The symptom appeared in the same change that corrected AUDCTL behavior.
contradicting_evidence: Restoring the old AUDCTL read behavior alone did not advance the title.
Restoring the old AUDCTL write behavior alone did not advance the title.
hypotheses.falsifying_test: Hold sector routing fixed and independently substitute the prior AUDCTL read and write behaviors.

context.scenario: Hotel Mario USA boot, shell PLAY click, then Player 1 click

experiments.strategy: Compare c012d17 and 36b46f7 before normalizing the scripted input harness.
assumptions: The CLI generated the same guest-visible pointer sequence at both revisions.
experiments.expected: A CDIC regression causes the revisions to diverge.
experiments.actual: Both stalled with framebuffer SHA-256 050159189bd72c6d404bea6a4c0e1b3fb2efc54de3b32a3fe3f34b07d012ddde, but the shared press-boundary re-anchor invalidated the input-equivalence assumption.

conditions: Only comparisons using the faulty press-boundary re-anchor.
repeat_when: Never as evidence about core CDIC behavior without first normalizing input.

context.scenario: Hotel Mario USA boot, shell PLAY click, then Player 1 click

experiments.strategy: Remove the CLI re-anchor, bisect the CDIC subchanges, then route the selected XA header to data buffer 0/1 and the complete post-sync image to ADPCM buffer 4/5.
assumptions: The recorded Mono-I buffer observations apply to the CD-i 220 F2 path.
The known-good NEW / RESTORE framebuffer identifies a completed Player 1 transition.
experiments.expected: The corrected layout reaches NEW / RESTORE while retaining DBUF 4/5, AUDCTL gating, and buffered XA playback.
experiments.actual: The run reached NEW / RESTORE with the known-good framebuffer SHA-256 6d5538365145dfef95634bff36f756be7e646ea0b31bc7d1de294d4adce1e481, PC 0x004081aa, 3,968,270,721 CPU cycles, 381,310 exceptions, and 3,777,312 emitted audio samples. Focused CDIC tests also pass.
improvements: Hotel Mario Player 1 transition advances deterministically.
Selected XA delivery now preserves both CD-RTOS header visibility and hardware ADPCM offsets.

conditions: CD-i 220 F2 selected Mode-2 XA delivery and the recorded Hotel Mario scenario.
invalidated_by: Changes to CDIC sector routing, DBUF selection, pointer packet timing, or disc identity.
repeat_when: Any invalidating dependency changes or a real-hardware byte dump contradicts the dual-routing layout.
